Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the management of the wildstock geoduck resource.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the role of the department of fish and wildlifein the management of the state wildstock geoduck resource; and amendingRCW 79.135.220.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 79.135.220 and 2005 c 155 s 709 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) It is the responsibility of the department ((shall)) todesignate the areas of stateowned aquatic lands that are available forgeoduck harvesting by licensed geoduck harvesters in accordance withthis chapter ((79.90 RCW)). (2) For the state's management of the geoduck fishery, it is theprimary responsibility of the department of fish and wildlife to: (a) Identify commercial geoduck tracks; (b) Conduct geoduck fishery assessments and recovery and mortalityrate studies; (c) Set the total allowable catch limits for the harvest ofwildstock geoducks from stateowned aquatic lands.
